title: Новые правила и сожжённое меню  (New Rules and the Burned Menu)

scenes.title: The Turnstile and New Rules
scenes.summary: Vika installs a turnstile at the staff entrance and announces corporate fines to an outraged Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Caps and Gloves
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov fumes as his cooks wear sanitary caps and gloves, while Fedya and Senya tease Max about Vika's return.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Sold the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov demands that Nagiyev protect his kitchen, but Nagiyev admits he sold 100% of the restaurant.

scenes.title: Just Working Together
scenes.summary: Nagiyev says he is now only the face of the restaurant, and Vika tells Max that they are merely coworkers.

scenes.title: The Secret About Kissing Katya
scenes.summary: Max tells Kostya that he kissed Katya and fears Vika will find out, while Kostya advises him to be honest with Katya.

scenes.title: The Broken Turnstile
scenes.summary: Eva snoops into Max's secret with Katya, while Chef Barinov rips out the entrance turnstile and brings it to Vika.

scenes.title: Rebellion Against the Gloves
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov destroys the kitchen's rubber gloves and mocks the corporate award until Vika calls him into the office.

scenes.title: The Two-Million Bonus
scenes.summary: Vika wins Chef Barinov's compliance by revealing that the chain offers him a two-million-ruble year-end bonus.

scenes.title: Caring About Katya
scenes.summary: Katya kisses Max, and Max pretends he only wants to keep their romance secret so Vika will not fire her.

scenes.title: Chebureki on the French Menu
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov suddenly enforces Vika's rules and agrees to add okroshka and chebureki to the French menu.

scenes.title: Ban on Workplace Romances
scenes.summary: Max flirts with Vika in the dining room and then lies to Katya that Vika bans workplace romances.

scenes.title: We Shared an Orange
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya blackmail Chef Barinov over his sudden obedience, demanding a share of his secret bribe.

scenes.title: An Honest Talk with Katya
scenes.summary: Max interrupts Katya and Vika in a panic, then honestly confesses to Katya that he still loves Vika.

scenes.title: The Letter of Resignation
scenes.summary: Max tells Chef Barinov that he has betrayed his culinary principles and puts his resignation letter on the desk.

scenes.title: A Freudian Slip and a Bonfire
scenes.summary: Max accidentally calls Vika 'Katya' at the bar, and Chef Barinov gathers the kitchen to burn the new menu.

scenes.title: The Chef Quits
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov burns the chain's new menu in front of Vika and quits when she threatens to fine him.

scenes.title: Smile, Elvira
scenes.summary: Max comforts a discouraged Vika and makes her smile by recalling the fake names she gave him when they first met.

scenes.title: Let's Start Over
scenes.summary: Max and Vika reconcile with a kiss, while Andrey Mikhailovich tells Chef Barinov that Vika actually defended him.

scenes.title: Vika's Condition
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov learns that Vika saved Claude Monet from becoming a German beer hall and protected his job.

scenes.title: The Return of Pregnant Sasha
scenes.summary: Sasha visits Claude Monet visibly pregnant and stuns Max by revealing that she and Ilya broke up and the baby is not Ilya's.
